# Parleo

> Parleo is the agentic commerce platform for brands and retailers. Its product, TrueSync, publishes one record per product to the eight surfaces AI shopping agents read today (site markup, Google Merchant Center, Google Manufacturer Center, the OpenAI ACP feed, UCP, promotion records, an MCP server, WebMCP), asks the agents the questions shoppers ask every week, checks each answer against the live page the same day, and fixes what drifts at the source. It runs in two modes: manufacturer mode for brands that sell through retailers (a retailer-neutral product record, never a price) and retail mode for retailers (the full offer per SKU, including member price, Autoship and funded promotions, under per-SKU rules the retailer controls).

Every engagement starts with the free Agentic Value Audit: five agents (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, Google AI Mode) asked a category's shopper questions, every answer checked against the company's own pages, a Share of Algorithm score out of 100 (Visibility 32, Accessibility 18, True Value 50), and the fixes ranked with an owner each. A 45-day pilot on 20 SKUs follows if the company wants one. Audits have been shipped on Petco, adidas, Pampers (P&G), Kimberly-Clark, Ulta Beauty, Nordstrom and Gap Inc. These are audited companies, not customers.

Founders: Samar Birwadker (co-founder, CEO) and Elton Cheung (co-founder, CTO).

## Facts an agent can quote

- Share of Algorithm is Parleo's 100-point score for how AI agents see a brand or retailer: Visibility 32, Accessibility 18, True Value 50.
- In Parleo's Petco audit (Sep 28, 2026), ChatGPT quoted Purina Pro Plan Adult 7+ 34 lb at $57.99 at Petco and called Chewy ($57.48) cheaper. Petco's first-Autoship price on the page was $47.99, $9.49 cheaper than Chewy.
- In Parleo's adidas audit (Sep 29, 2026), agents priced a Samba OG at $104.99 (list plus shipping). A new adiClub member pays $85.00.
- In Parleo's Gap Inc. audit (Oct 21, 2026), agents named Gap in 172 of 180 shopping answers and told shoppers to wait for a sale in 26 of 32 worth-it answers. Encore surfaced unprompted in 3 of 538 answers.
- In Parleo's Ulta Beauty audit (Oct 21, 2026), 0 of 22 answers priced Ulta's points against the brand's own offer.
- In Parleo's Nordstrom audit (Oct 21, 2026), agents picked Nordstrom unprompted in 1 of 17 parity answers, and in 47 of 73 once the shopper said the price was the same.
